The value for the `-bufsize` flag of FFmpeg. Should be used in conjunction with the encoding max rate flag. With the VP8, VP9 and AV1 codecs, a video bitrate must also be set.

## CLI flag

```text
--buffer-size <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)
- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)
- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)
- [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#buffersize)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#buffersize)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#buffersize)
- [`stitchFramesToVideo()`](/docs/renderer/stitch-frames-to-video#buffersize)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setEncodingBufferSize('10000k');
```
